## Why visit

A substantial reason to consider Urmston rather than another undirected suburban pub crawl. The emphasis on local cask and cider sits alongside carefully chosen international bottles, so it can satisfy both the regional discovery brief and specialist tastes. Its quiet drinking-parlour approach works well for comparing beers and talking to staff. This is a useful cider-led alternative to the central-city route, particularly if a tasting or interesting bottle selection is confirmed; otherwise combine it with time in the surrounding town rather than rushing out for one drink.

## Beer

Four rotating handpulled ales, with independent Manchester breweries prominent, alongside eight craft taps and take-home bottles/cans.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** Official site describes real cider; CAMRA names Hogan’s draught and producers such as Dunham Press and Ross-on-Wye among bottles/boxes. Check individual products and availability.
